title: Smile Restaurant of Hell
description:
In a hell where only despair exists, a mysterious restaurant opens its doors. Collect 1000 tips, and you'll earn your ticket back to the world of the living. Hikaru, our protagonist, takes a job there hoping to escape hell... but what awaits?

(Source: MANGA Plus)
